title: Fatty-Liver-NLP-Phenotyping
description: Research software accompanying a JMIR Medical Informatics manuscript on ultrasound-reported hepatic steatosis phenotyping and associated metabolic profiles in health examination records. The release contains the exact rule-based NLP implementation used in the study, rule dictionaries and lexicons, synthetic examples, tests, and reproducible aggregate-analysis code. Yong Fang and Liqun Shi contributed equally to the associated research. No patient-level data, identifiers, or real clinical narratives are included. The software is provided for research reproducibility and is not a clinical diagnostic system.
